Name: Rosetta
Text: I'm... I'm fine, 【kuroname】. I just need a moment to rest.

Name: Commandant
Text: Your wounds haven't worsened, Rosetta. But you're still seeing hallucinations, aren't you?

Name: Commandant
Text: The damage to your M.I.N.D. might be worsening. We'll have to wait until we get back to Babylonia to repair it.

Name: Rosetta
Text: Don't worry, they're just scratches. They won't get in the way of our evacuation plan.

Name: Rosetta
Text: The blizzard hasn't reached its worst yet. Come sit with me for a bit, 【kuroname】.

Name: Commandant
Text: Rosetta, let's go over the evacuation plan one more time.

Name: Rosetta
Text: We'll use the blizzard to cover us, outsmart the enemy, and complete the evacuation.

Name: Rosetta
Text: That's a bold plan, 【kuroname】... but I'm on board.

Name: Commandant
Text: The blizzard isn't fully on our side. We need to prepare for the worst-case scenario—getting separated.

Name: Rosetta
Text: If we get separated... don't try to find me. If you run into enemy patrols in the blizzard...

Name: Rosetta
Text: It's too risky... We need to head to the evacuation point separately. 【kuroname】, I know we'll meet there.

Name: Commandant
Text: Let's double-check the comms. If we get separated, at least we'll be able to stay in touch. Rosetta, can you hear me clearly?

Name: Rosetta
Text: It's very clear, and the connection's stable. It's like you're speaking right next to me, 【kuroname】.

Name: Commandant
Text: We've still got some time before we leave. Rosetta, get some rest and conserve your energy.

Name: Rosetta
Text: Yeah, you should rest too, 【kuroname】.

Name: Rosetta
Text: 【kuroname】... come closer... the blizzard is so fierce... please hold me tight...

Name: Rosetta
Text: 【kuroname】... so warm...

Name: Rosetta
Text: 【kuroname】, I think I just had a dream...

Name: Rosetta
Text: I'm sorry, 【kuroname】, what time is it now?

Name: Commandant
Text: Have you rested enough? The blizzard's picking up. It's the perfect time for us to head out.

Name: Commandant
Text: (Looks like Rosetta's injury is slowing her down. Gotta finish the evacuation quickly.)

Name: Commandant
Text: Come on, lean on me.

Name: Rosetta
Text: 【kuroname】... thank you.

Name: Rosetta
Text: If only... my thrusters hadn't been damaged...

Name: Commandant
Text: It's okay. We made it this far without the thrusters, didn't we?

Name: Commandant
Text: It's because we've been supporting each other that we've made it this far, right, Rosetta?

Name: Rosetta
Text: But... the blizzard's getting worse, and we've barely covered a quarter of our route...

Name: Rosetta
Text: This won't work. 【kuroname】, you need to go on ahead... I'll... I'll catch up with you later.

Name: Commandant
Text: What are you talking about? We're going back to Babylonia together. Just hang on a little longer, Rosetta.

Name: Commandant
Text: This is the final stretch. The evacuation point is just ahead.

Name: Rosetta
Text: Alright... I'll hang on. I'll make it to the evacuation point with you, 【kuroname】.

Name: Mechanoid A
Text: Footprints? Humans can't move fast in this blizzard. They're probably not far ahead.

Name: Rosetta
Text: Damn it, running into pursuers now... 【kuroname】, we...

Name: Commandant
Text: They haven't spotted us yet. Let's find cover and hide.

Name: Commandant
Text: This spot's well-hidden. We should be safe here.

Name: Rosetta
Text: ...【kuroname】, hurry and get in here.

Name: Commandant
Text: Wait here and stay quiet. I'll check the enemy's movements.

Name: Mechanoid A
Text: Footprints lead that way. Go search that area.

Name: Mechanoid B
Text: In this blizzard? How could humans possibly be out here...

Name: Mechanoid B
Text: Hm?

Name: Commandant
Text: Feeling nervous? It's okay. Go ahead and put your hand here.

Name: Commandant
Text: They're gone. That was too close. Let's keep moving.

Name: Rosetta
Text: 【kuroname】, I'm feeling better now. I can walk on my own from here.

Name: Rosetta
Text: Umm... my legs are numb from staying in that position...

Name: Commandant
Text: The wind's still too strong. Rosetta, get behind me. I'll shield you.

Name: Commandant
Text: Rosetta, you holding up okay? Want to take a break?

Name: Rosetta
Text: I'm fine... 【kuroname】, I can keep going. Let's move forward.

Name: Commandant
Text: Rosetta, feel that? The wind's letting up a bit.

Name: Commandant
Text: We're halfway there. Just a bit longer, and we'll reach the evacuation point.

Name: Commandant
Text: Rosetta, if you need to rest, just let me know.

Name: Commandant
Text: Shh...! I think there are enemies ahead.

Name: Commandant
Text: Hold up. I think there are enemies ahead.
